_comment: Speak the agent's messages aloud in `aca chat` using the offline Kokoro-82M model. Install the extra first (`pip install 'aca[tts]'`), then copy this to <data-dir>/config.json. This is client-side rendering only — nothing here touches cognition or durable state, and audio never leaves the host. Default voice is `am_onyx` (American male); `lang_code` is auto-derived from the voice's first letter. Leave `provider` at `none` to keep the agent silent.
